items.rationale: Insured event under 2.6.2/2.6.4; battery waiver agreed so 2.6.8 does not apply; repair uneconomic per supplier report (7.1.10), so the equivalent replacement is indemnified at the upper end of the market price for a comparable laptop. Any deductible is not stated.
7.1.9 bars improvement over the pre-loss standard; the difference is borne by the policyholder.
Same event, separate unit assessed under 2.6.3/2.6.4; screen breakage is covered under 2.6.3(a).
Examination cost under 5.2.3 is covered even where repair proves uneconomic, capped at EUR 250 incl. VAT per event; the customary price is likely below the cap.
The bag was not damaged; 4.2.6 and 7.1.5 exclude renewal of an undamaged accessory or carrying case.
Warranty and future-performance undertakings are excluded by 3.5(f), 4.3(f) and 7.1.8(e).
Data recovery is excluded under 3.5(d) and 4.3(c) unless additionally agreed; nothing indicates it was agreed.
Administrative charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b); the fee also attaches to the excluded data work.
